metadata.description: Security auditor and guard-builder for vibecoded apps (web, AI/LLM, mobile, desktop, backend, CI/CD). Community project for the Israeli Claude / Claude Code / vibe-coding group. Not an official Anthropic product.

plugins.name: claudeguard-il
plugins.description: Audit any vibecoded app for vulnerabilities and missing guards, then generate paste-ready hardening code. Covers secrets, Supabase/Firebase RLS, auth/IDOR, LLM/prompt-injection, Android/iOS, Electron, IaC and CI/CD. Static by default; gated live and DAST tiers. Bilingual HE/EN reports.
